authors: MarketAlly Pte Ltd, David H. Friedel Jr.
description: PDF page rendering and text extraction for OpenMaui apps on Linux, on Google's PDFium (bundled for linux-x64 and linux-arm64, no host dependency). PdfiumDocument renders pages to SkiaSharp bitmaps or PNG and reads their text; .UseLinuxPdf() also makes Syncfusion's PdfToImageConverter (and so SfPdfViewer) render on Linux, where its platform-neutral build has no renderer. Opt-in: install this package only if your app shows PDFs on Linux.
